_说明: 抢房准备的演示数据（静态网页用）。opens 是预计开放预订的日期（YYYY-MM-DD），status 是 open 已开放 / soon 即将开放 / waitlist 候补 / soldout 售罄 / unknown 待核对。连上服务器后网页改读 /api/availability：服务器按 consult-server/lib/availability-sources.json 定时查官网公开页面，自动更新状态。
_how_to: Demo data for Booking prep (static site). opens is the expected booking date; status is open / soon / waitlist / soldout / unknown. With the server connected the page reads /api/availability instead, which checks official public pages listed in consult-server/lib/availability-sources.json.
